answers.answer: The packet never says 'private invitation report' or 'reviewer' — it frames the change as 'This pull request changes who makes the LinkedIn invitation shortlist.' The behaviour change: the capacity check moved from one employer per person to every employer — old 'if slots[candidate_row.company_id] <= 0:' (line 1018) becomes 'if any(slots[company_id] <= 0 for company_id in employers[candidate_row.profile_url].assignments):' (line 1031), and a selected person now charges a slot to every company ('slots[company_id] -= 1', lines 1034-1035). Before, 'A had one employer on record, say co-a, so only co-a's limit was checked' and 'Nothing stopped A, and co-b's people got a fourth invitation'; now 'A needs a free slot at every company A works at', and when both have room 'A is invited once and uses a slot at each' ('2 left' at co-a and co-b). It changes the outcome for people with two jobs at once (Person A, 'two current jobs') under the per-company cap of 3 invitations ('max(0, 3 - company_counts[company_id])', line 1038).
